subject: spanish
title: Opinions About Subjects
welcome_lead: Apply your knowledge: give and justify opinions about your school subjects.
meta_desc: GCSE Spanish application adventure on school subject opinions.
final_note: ¡Muy bien! Your opinions are now well-justified.

concepts.def: I like (one thing) — use with singular subject.

walkthroughs.body_html: Gustar is special: use me gusta for one thing (singular noun) and me gustan for plurals. Me gusta el inglés (I like English). Me gustan las matemáticas (I like maths). Negative: No me gusta / No me gustan.
Always give a reason! Singular: Me gusta la historia porque es interesante. Plural: No me gustan las matemáticas porque son difíciles. Note the adjective also becomes plural to match.

Boost your marks with variety: me encanta (I love), odio (I hate), prefiero (I prefer), mi asignatura favorita es (my favourite subject is). Example: Mi asignatura favorita es el arte porque es creativa y fácil.

mcqs.q: Which is correct for 'I like maths'?

numericals.q: How many subjects in 'Estudio inglés, español, historia, arte y matemáticas'?

free_texts.q: Write the Spanish for 'I prefer' (no accents).
